The '''Ministry of Land Management''' was a governmental building on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. [[Imperial Advisor/Legends|Imperial Advisor]] [[Fendrilon Koozar]] once crashed his luxury [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] into the ministry building in a fit of hallucination, killing himself, after being poisoned.
